topic: Starship reaches orbit for the first time on Flight 14
First quantum photonic processor operated in orbit (University of Vienna)
Figure retires its F.02 humanoid robots by having them leap into molten steel (Finland)
Apple Pay launches in India with Axis Bank (no UPI, no RuPay)
Nobel Prize in Medicine 2026 for optogenetics (Deisseroth, Hegemann, Nagel)
Nobel Prize in Physics 2026 for IceCube and high-energy cosmic neutrinos (Francis Halzen)
Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra pre-orders with Nvidia RTX Spark superchip (Oct 7 Windows & Surface event)
GPT-6 brings Intelligent UI to ChatGPT (interactive answers; paid Oct 7, Free & Go Oct 8)
Google Cloud launches Gemini agent, a universal agent for work (Gemini at Work, Oct 8)
Tesla renames FSD (Supervised) to 'Tesla Assisted Driving' in Europe after Germany calls the name misleading
Anthropic updates Claude usage policy to bar sustained, needless cruelty toward its models (announced Oct 8, effective Nov 12)
Meta releases Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its first frontier-class models (Meta Superintelligence Labs, Oct 12)
Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2026 for mirror-image molecules: non-linear effects and asymmetric autocatalysis (Henri Kagan, Kenso Soai); carvone spearmint vs caraway hook
NASA's Perseverance rover sets the off-world driving record (45.22 km / 28.10 mi on Oct 11, passing Opportunity; AutoNav >90%)
Amazon launches Bee Frontier ($74.99 AI wearable, on sale Oct 15) and Bee Eclipse ($99.99 phone attachment, coming soon); Bee Pro $11.99/mo
Meta releases Muse Spark Open, an 816B-parameter open-weight model (42B active, 1M context) optimized with Apple to run on two M5 Ultra Mac Studios (Oct 15)

Astronomers identify the first known green star: white dwarf WD J1330+6435 tinted chartreuse by sodium from planetary debris (Warwick, RASTI, Oct 16); plus a pink carbon white dwarf, maybe the reddest star

Microsoft pulls out of Nscale's planned Loughton (Essex) AI data centre after UK Power Networks reportedly can't supply enough power until the early-to-mid 2030s (Telegraph Oct 18, Reuters Oct 19; 50 MW site, scalable to 90 MW)

One hacker's AI agents attempted 1,200+ websites and reached sites at 100+ companies incl. John Deere, SharkNinja, Cummins (Reuters exclusive Oct 19; researcher Snorre Fagerland/NorForge via exposed Cairn panels; ~$50 of AI per break-in, rough estimate)

Nvidia and Agile Robots unveil Agile ONE SN reference humanoid at GTC Berlin (Oct 21): 1.40 m, WUJI Hand 2 hands with 20 DoF each + 1 kHz force control + touch, Isaac GR00T + Jetson Thor, setup weeks->days (Nvidia claim), 1,000-2,000 units planned (Agile CEO via Reuters), due early 2027

Anthropic opens Claude Duet, a proactive AI agent, as a research preview (Oct 21): flags what needs attention from connected apps, morning briefing, keeps working in the cloud, asks before sending/paying/signing/deleting; US Pro & Max waitlist

PHP2Shell: two critical PHP flaws (CVE-2026-109618/109619) found by Calif with OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and independently by Wiz; PHP patches Oct 21; NSA: patch now or take sites offline; sites worldwide went offline to patch; PHP ~70% of sites with known server language (W3Techs)

Apple iPhone Duo, first foldable iPhone, on sale Oct 23 ($1,999): 5.4-in outer / 7.6-in inner screens, 5.2 mm open, 254 g heaviest iPhone, Touch ID in side button replaces Face ID; preorders (Oct 16) sold out in ~30 min, new orders ship late Jan 2027
